title: feat(spec): push relay transport — transport: relay | direct on PushServiceConfigSchema, and the server-to-relay wire shape
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-support-ai"} -->
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwBTtCvLyK9Nh4zCRhhaC18tE)_
Fixes #29816

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: added
Skills-docs: none — nothing under `skills/**` or the hand-written docs names the push transport configuration or the relay (`git grep` over both, the generated `content/docs/references/` excepted, has zero hits); the transport is not authorable until its reader ships.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：推送配置现在有两种传输方式：默认走我们托管的推送中继（服务器用云绑定凭据认证，配置里不写任何密钥），白标应用才走直连 APNs/FCM；同时定义了服务器发给中继的请求、中继的逐个设备回执，以及 401/429 的错误格式。
- **为什么改**：cloud#3519 裁定商店版 App 的推送证书留在我们手里，所有服务器（私有部署也一样）都经中继推送，中继只看到不含内容的 ID；发送方（#29041）和云端中继需要同一份契约来对齐。
- **风险与回滚**：只加 spec 契约，没有任何读取方或路由，今天写什么都不生效；以前合法的推送配置全部照旧解析（不写 transport 时，带厂商块按直连、空配置按中继）。回滚即还原本 PR。
- **先看**：`packages/spec/src/system/push-config.zod.ts`（`PushServiceConfigSchema` 联合与两处混合形态拒收）、`packages/spec/src/api/push-relay.zod.ts`（载荷只含 ID 与一行通用文案、三种回执、错误信封）、`packages/spec/src/system/push-config.test.ts`。
- **两分钟验证**：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 src/system/push-config.test.ts src/api/push-relay.test.ts`，应看到 2 个文件全部通过（74 个用例）。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## What changes

**`PushServiceConfigSchema` is a `transport` discriminated union** (`packages/spec/src/system/push-config.zod.ts`), both members built with `strictObject`:

- `PushRelayTransportConfigSchema` — `{ transport: 'relay', endpoint? }`, the default. The hosted relay holds the store app's APNs and FCM credentials and authenticates the server by its cloud binding credential (cloud ADR-0008, the `oscc_…` bearer), so the block carries no credential. `endpoint` is for a staging relay only, an https URL (every request carries the binding); absent means the production relay. No production URL is written into the spec: that address is the cloud's to publish.
- `PushDirectTransportConfigSchema` — `{ transport: 'direct', apns?, fcm? }`, today's shape, for a white-label build. The APNs and FCM blocks are unchanged.
- The two mixed shapes are refused when written:
  - a credential inside a relay block. A vendor block (`apns`, `fcm`) or a credential-shaped key (`credentialRef`, `credential`, `token`, `apiKey`, `key`, `secret`) is refused by name: `unrecognized_keys` at path `[]`, message "Not authorable on the relay push transport. …", pointing at `transport: 'direct'`.
  - a direct block with no vendor block, so no `credentialRef`: a `custom` issue at path `[]`, message "A direct push transport names at least one vendor block (`apns` or `fcm`), each with its `credentialRef`. …". The rule is the projectable `requiredOneOf(['apns', 'fcm'])`, so the published JSON Schema carries it as `anyOf` `required` and `dropped-refinements` does not move. A vendor block missing its `credentialRef` was already refused at `['apns', 'credentialRef']` and still is.
- `endpoint` on a direct block is refused by name, pointing at the relay.
- **A block without `transport` keeps parsing.** Both members default their `transport` literal, and the union is built with `unionFallback: true`, so an absent tag is tried as the relay and then as direct: `{}` reads as the relay, and a block with an `apns` or `fcm` block reads as direct. A block that names `transport` is judged by that member alone, so its refusals carry that member's path and message.
- Every `[PLANNED — not yet read]` marker stays, and the two new members carry one.
- The docblock is rewritten: the hosted relay is the default and direct is for white-label builds. The sentence putting a hosted surface out of scope is gone.
- `PushServiceConfigParsed`, `PushRelayTransportConfigParsed` and `PushDirectTransportConfigParsed` are declared: parsing fills in `transport`, so author and parsed shapes differ (ADR-0122). `Iso_system_pushConfig__PushServiceConfigSchema` leaves the pin file.

**New `packages/spec/src/api/push-relay.zod.ts`**, one wire shape for the sender (#29041) and the cloud relay:

- `PushRelayRequestSchema`: `{ deliveries: [{ token, vendor, payload, priority }] }`, at least one delivery, strict. The binding credential is the request's bearer; the body carries none.
- `PushRelayPayloadSchema` (ID-only, ruling 2A): `{ data, text }`. `data` is `PushDeliveryDataSchema` (notification id, same-server route, origin); `text` is one generic visible line. `title`, `body`, `subtitle`, `message` and `content` are refused by name. Opaque to the relay: it puts the payload in the vendor message unchanged.
- `PushRelayPrioritySchema`: `high` or `normal`. `vendor` is the existing `PushVendorSchema`, still `apns | fcm`.
- `PushRelayResponseSchema`: `{ results: [{ token, status }] }`, one result per delivery in request order. `PushRelayResultStatusSchema` is `ok`, `invalid` (the vendor reports the token dead: stop delivering to it) or `retry` (transient: send again later). A vendor refusal is a result, never an error status.
- `PushRelayErrorResponseSchema`: the error for a whole request.

**What the error envelope reuses:**

- The house envelope `ErrorResponseSchema` (`api/errors.zod.ts`), with `error` narrowed to `PushRelayErrorSchema`.
- That is a union on `code` of three `EnhancedApiErrorSchema.extend(...)` members, each using an existing `StandardErrorCode`. No new error code and no ledger row.
- 401 is `UNAUTHENTICATED`, with `details.reason` set to `binding_invalid` or `binding_revoked`.
- 429 request pacing is `RATE_LIMIT_EXCEEDED`. It requires `retryAfterSeconds`, the house rate-limit field that names the wait (the relay sends the same value in `Retry-After`).
- 429 quota is `QUOTA_EXCEEDED`. `retryAfterSeconds` is optional there.
- On both 429s the `code` is the reason. All three require `helpText`, the house "suggested actions" field, as the next step.

**Not changed, per the card:** `PushVendorSchema` stays `apns | fcm`, and `RegisterDeviceRequestSchema` gains no `pushKey`. The ADR-0012 amendment is #29817.

**Generated artifacts** are regenerated and committed: `api-surface/`, `export-origins/`, `declaration-map/`, `json-schema.manifest/`, `authorable-surface/`, `authorable-defaults/`, the strictness-ledger counts and `content/docs/references/` (new `api/push-relay.mdx`).

## Tests

- `packages/spec/src/system/push-config.test.ts` pins:
  - the default: `{}` parses to `{ transport: 'relay' }`;
  - the relay with and without a staging endpoint, and the refusal of a non-https one;
  - direct with both vendors or either one alone;
  - the shape written before `transport` existed reading as direct;
  - each mixed-shape refusal, with its issue code, path and message's first sentence: the vendor blocks and the credential keys in a relay block, a direct block with no vendor, a direct vendor block without `credentialRef`, and `endpoint` on direct;
  - a transport outside the two; unknown keys;
  - the `PLANNED` marker on all five schemas.
- `packages/spec/src/api/push-relay.test.ts` pins:
  - the request: both vendors and priorities, an empty batch refused, no credential in the body, each required delivery member;
  - the ID-only payload: `title`, `body` and `subtitle` refused by name, `data` judged by `PushDeliveryDataSchema`;
  - the response: each per-token result `ok`, `invalid` and `retry`, batch order, an unknown outcome refused;
  - the 401 envelope for both reasons, and both 429 envelopes;
  - each missing reason, wait or next step refused at its path; a code the relay does not answer with refused;
  - the `PLANNED` marker on seven schemas.
- `type-alias-convention.pin.test.ts`: 822 → 828. The `PushServiceConfigSchema` pin leaves (-1) and the seven isomorphic relay schemas are pinned (+7). Both error schemas carry `…Parsed`, because the house envelope's `retryable` defaults.

## Acceptance notes

- **Narrowing measurement (the order's mechanism assumption).** Read on `packages/spec/dist` at `06321962`. Every JSON document that parses on `main` still parses: `{}` reads as the relay, and `{ apns }`, `{ fcm }` and `{ apns, fcm }` read as direct with their content unchanged. One value `main` accepts is refused here, and it is JavaScript-only, not JSON: a config whose vendor members are present as `undefined` with no vendor block at all, such as `{ apns: undefined }`. `main` parsed it and it delivered to nothing. Here the strict relay block sees the key, and the direct block finds no vendor. `{ fcm: CONFIG, apns: undefined }` still parses as direct. Nothing reads this schema (`[PLANNED — not yet read]`). Declaring `apns` and `fcm` as undefined-only keys on the relay block would avoid it, but would put phantom keys on the relay's authorable surface and published JSON Schema. So the declaration stays `yes (widening)` and the residue is named here for the seat's contract review.
- **`{}` changes its declared meaning.** On `main` it read as "no vendor delivers"; here it reads as "the relay", the default the card rules. Nothing reads the shape, so no deployment's behaviour moves. `Metadata-protocol: added` is kept: `check-changeset-no-major` reads `added` from the moved shards.
- **Authorable-surface lines moved, not removed.** `system/PushServiceConfig:apns` and `:fcm` left the baseline: a union has no top-level keys for the walk to list. They re-appear as `system/PushDirectTransportConfig:apns` and `:fcm`. The build's check (c) proved the deletion itself: the def is not reachable from the 33 metadata-type roots.
- **"ADR-0008" is cloud ADR-0008.** In this repository ADR-0008 is the metadata repository and change log, so the code cites `cloud ADR-0008`, as `packages/cloud-connection` does. A cloud-hosted server reaches the control plane with `OS_CLOUD_API_KEY`, not an `oscc_` bearer. Which credential such a server presents to the relay is the cloud relay's to state (`carrier: cloud`). This PR only says the binding credential is the bearer.
- **Overlap with #29794 (#29041's reader), ruled serial by the seat.** That draft also edits `push-config.zod.ts`: it takes the `[PLANNED — not yet read]` markers off and reads the top-level `apns` / `fcm` blocks in `@objectstack/service-push`. The seat ruled this card lands first and holds #29041 behind it. So #29794 owes the `transport` narrowing in service-push when it merges (read the direct member; say what a relay config does there), and this PR does not touch service-push. On that merge the markers come off the direct member only: the relay member keeps its marker until something reads it.
- **Explicit-transport errors.** An unknown `transport` value (for example `'hms'`) answers zod's `invalid_union` with both members' literal mismatches, because `unionFallback` tries every member. The house formatter picks the branch.

## Verification

All readings at head `88fe2df6` (the merge of `origin/main` `4b71a82b`) unless a line names another commit. Every command ran under `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`. Each verdict is the lock's `VERDICT` line or an exit code captured before any pipe.

- Full build: `pnpm exec turbo run build --concurrency=2` at `726a5aa4`: `Tasks: 118 successful, 118 total`, VERDICT command-exit 0.
- After merging main: `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec check:generated --fix` regenerated `api-surface/system.json` and `export-origins/system.json`; then `check:generated` exit 0, "All 14 generated artifacts are up to date".
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test && pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck`: Test Files 808 passed (808), Tests 24107 passed and 1 todo; typecheck ran `tsc --noEmit`, `check:scripts-typecheck` and `check:test-typecheck`. VERDICT command-exit 0. At `726a5aa4`, before the merge: 808 files, 24067 tests, exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test:repo` at `726a5aa4`: Test Files 89 passed (89), Tests 1522 passed (1522), VERDICT command-exit 0.
- `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config` on the six touched source and test files: exit 0.
- The two new suites alone: Test Files 2 passed, Tests 74 passed.

</details>

<details><summary>Ablation of the mixed-shape refusals (one run, each leg restored)</summary>

Both legs used `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --file packages/spec/src/system/push-config.zod.ts … -- vitest run src/system/push-config.test.ts`. The tests import the module from `src/`, so no dist leg is needed. After each leg the tool restored the file: blob `6f536835` equal to HEAD, and `git diff HEAD` empty.

- **Leg A** dropped the direct block's `.refine(requiredOneOf(['apns', 'fcm']), …)`. The marker `ABLATED_NO_VENDOR_RULE` went 0 to 1 and the anchor 1 to 0. Result: 2 failed of 37, "refuses a direct block with no vendor block, so no credentialRef" and "judges each transport block on its own too".
- **Leg B** dropped the relay block's `apns` and `fcm` guidance rows. The marker `ABLATED_RELAY_VENDOR_GUIDANCE` went 0 to 1 and the anchor 1 to 0. Result: 1 failed of 37, "refuses a vendor block inside a relay block, by name, pointing at direct". The key is still refused there, but without the prescription.
- The first leg-A attempt used `)` as the replacement, which is not a countable marker. The tool refused it (count moved by -2, not +1) and restored the file. That attempt was a no-op and is not counted.

</details>

<details><summary>Gates</summary>

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` derives 102 commands at `88fe2df6`, the same list as at `726a5aa4`. All 102 exit 0, run serially with stdin closed and the exit captured before any pipe. `--ran` reconciles 102 derived, 102 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN; the event-body run of `check-changeset-no-major` is recorded outside the derivation.
- First pass at `06321962`: two reds. `check:llms-txt` (`llms.txt` counted 216 schemas and 34 for `api`) and `check:variant-docs` (the new error union on `PushRelayErrorResponseSchema.error` was undeclared). Both were fixed in `726a5aa4`: the counts and the `api` row now name the relay module, and the union has a `not-authorable` (wire protocol) row in `variant-docs.json`.
- Seven gates exited 3 until the full build existed: `check:doc-formula-expressions`, `check:doc-security-posture`, `check:skill-examples`, `check:docs-transcript-drift`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` and `check:lean-entry-closure`. The seventh, `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test`, needed its pinned fixture commit fetched into the shallow clone; there was no file change.
- `GITHUB_EVENT_NAME=pull_request node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs --base origin/main --event FILE` with this body: exit 0. The level axis reads `Clause-②: yes (widening)` and `Metadata-protocol: added`, and no moved package is graded `patch`. Control with `Metadata-protocol: none`: exit 1, "moves a metadata-protocol baseline".
- Dogfood battery: n/a. The title has no `!` and there is no `(narrowing)` arm.

</details>
